scope: Seed zero, smallest selection, preserved original and repaired three-demo/four-query lesson only.
intended_program:
(rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((stage (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
    (let ((cells (map (lambda (p)
                        (list (+ (obj-r1 obj) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj)))
                              (+ (obj-c1 obj) (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)))))
                      (obj-cells obj))))
      (paint-cells out cells (obj-color obj))))) (groups (objects stage 0)))
      (if (empty? groups) stage
        (let* ((score (lambda (obj) (obj-size obj)))
               (best (apply min (map score groups)))
               (eligible (filter (lambda (obj) (= (score obj) best)) groups)))
          (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows stage) (cols stage) 0)))
                     ((obj (in-list eligible)) (p (in-list (obj-cells obj))))
            (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (at stage (first p) (second p)))))))))
